fields.Appearance: Young, ink-stained, and sleep-deprived, carrying more books than practical supplies.
fields.Backstory: A student found evidence contradicting the central claim of a celebrated professor.
fields.Goals: Verify the discovery and present it without destroying innocent academic careers.

fields.Appearance: Absent-minded and formally dressed, with spectacles repaired in several places.
fields.Backstory: A researcher spent decades on a theory dismissed until recent events proved it dangerously correct.
fields.Goals: Warn authorities and finish the work before opportunists weaponize it.

fields.Appearance: Quiet, precise, and burdened with scroll cases, sealing wax, and cramped handwriting.
fields.Backstory: A scribe noticed official decrees are being subtly altered between copying and publication.
fields.Goals: Preserve authentic records and identify the authority behind the changes.

fields.Appearance: Dusty, soft-spoken, and watchful, with keys to collections most visitors never see.
fields.Backstory: A librarian discovered a supposedly destroyed book repeatedly returning under different titles.
fields.Goals: Understand the book's purpose and prevent reckless readers from activating it.

fields.Appearance: Field-worn rather than academic, with notebooks, specimen jars, and sturdy travel boots.
fields.Backstory: An independent historian abandoned the university to investigate ruins local communities consider sacred.
fields.Goals: Document the past without exploiting its descendants and repair the damage caused by earlier expeditions.

fields.Appearance: Their bearing and equipment reflect an unusual and memorable career.
fields.Backstory: A meticulous chronicler who records contradictions in official history and keeps several versions of every event.
fields.Goals: Resolve the unfinished conflict without surrendering personal independence.

fields.Appearance: An older person with a valuable memory or reputation.
fields.Backstory: Their life stage has forced them into responsibilities that do not fit ordinary expectations.
fields.Goals: Prove their judgment while protecting the freedom to grow or change.

fields.Appearance: Clothing and tools immediately suggest the work of a scientist.
fields.Backstory: Built a life as a scientist and knows the profession’s obligations and hidden pressures.
fields.Goals: Use that experience to secure a safer and more independent future.

fields.Appearance: Clothing and tools immediately suggest the work of a researcher.
fields.Backstory: Built a life as a researcher and knows the profession’s obligations and hidden pressures.
fields.Goals: Use that experience to secure a safer and more independent future.

fields.Appearance: Clothing and tools immediately suggest the work of a scribe.

fields.Appearance: Clothing and tools immediately suggest the work of a physician.
fields.Backstory: Built a life as a physician and knows the profession’s obligations and hidden pressures.
fields.Goals: Use that experience to secure a safer and more independent future.

fields.Appearance: Clothing and tools immediately suggest the work of a sage.
fields.Backstory: Built a life as a sage and knows the profession’s obligations and hidden pressures.
fields.Goals: Use that experience to secure a safer and more independent future.

fields.Appearance: A distinctive figure remembered as Iri Quickchalk.
fields.Backstory: a goblin cartographer who maps rumors rather than roads and becomes offended when either proves inaccurate.
fields.Goals: Turn this unusual history toward a self-directed future.

fields.Appearance: A distinctive figure remembered as Professor Holloway.
fields.Backstory: a spectral historian possessing their own skeleton to continue field research.
fields.Goals: Turn this unusual history toward a self-directed future.

fields.Appearance: A distinctive figure remembered as Juniper Wake.
fields.Backstory: a botanist slowly turning into a tree and treating the transformation as a fascinating inconvenience.
fields.Goals: Turn this unusual history toward a self-directed future.
